references.text: Jethro, the priest of Midian, is the same priest mentioned here. Moses became his son-in-law after meeting his daughters at the well.
Jethro, the priest of Midian, is identified as Moses' father-in-law and confirms the connection to the priest in Midian.
Rebekah also came to a well to draw water, a similar motif where a future bride meets someone at a well.
Rachel came with her father's small livestock to the well, where she met Jacob. A parallel motif of women watering small livestock at a well.
Midian was one of Abraham's sons by Keturah and gives rise to the Midianites.
Hobab, son of Reuel from Midian, Moses' father-in-law, links back to this priest's family.
